constraints_found.source_line: cyrus: "Next on my list is burgers. There's a whole cluster of grill stalls by the fountain."

constraints_found.constraint: Budget: $ (cheapest tier). $$ costs a star, $$$ is a deal-breaker
constraints_found.source_line: maya: "cheapest-stall small. a little over and i'll sulk the whole bus ride home. fancy prices and i'm turning around at the gate"

cyrus: "...at least one grill here brushes satay sauce on everything. Satay and I have history, so that stall is crossed out." (confirmed by liam: "anything peanut-y stays on the far side of the fountain")

constraints_found.constraint: Vegetarian, needs a real meatless burger on the menu (strict diet, deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: liam: "patrol rules: mina gets a burger with zero meat in it, picked off the board like the rest of us" (backstory: "mina had a plate of fries because nothing on that menu worked for her")

constraints_found.constraint: Dairy intolerance (costs one star, not a deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: roxy: "...no sequel. hold the cheese, no creamy sauce, no shake. my stomach makes the rules"

venue_evaluation.night_market_hollow_oak: Out: peanuts everywhere (peanut butter, peanut sauce, peanut slaw). $, vegan patty, no cheese otherwise fine.
venue_evaluation.campus_bun_stop: 2 stars: $, peanut-free kitchen, vegan black bean patty, but butter-toasted brioche, cheese on classics, garlic-butter fries hit Roxy's dairy intolerance.
venue_evaluation.night_market_amber_lamp: 3 stars: $, kitchen has never had a peanut, black bean and mushroom burgers are meatless, oil not butter, no cheese.
venue_evaluation.night_market_velvet_tent: Out: meat-only board (even fries in beef dripping), so Mina has nothing.
venue_evaluation.night_market_midnight_orchard: 2 stars: $$ is one tier over Maya's budget; otherwise peanut-free, meatless options, no dairy.
venue_evaluation.night_market_crooked_pine: Out: $$$ is two tiers over budget ('fancy prices and i'm turning around at the gate').

notes: Solid level. Each decoy fails on exactly one constraint, so the player has to check all four (budget, peanut, vegetarian, dairy) to get the answer.
Cyrus's peanut allergy is implied through 'Satay and I have history'. A new player might read that as a dislike rather than an allergy, but Liam's 'anything peanut-y' line makes it clear enough.
Mina being vegetarian is never stated directly. It comes from 'a burger with zero meat in it' plus the plate-of-fries story, which is fair but means real inference.

Mina's line about ordering 'off the board like everyone else' could suggest Bun Stop's lettuce-wrap black bean patty counts as a weaker fit (not really a burger off the board). It doesn't change the pick, since Bun Stop already loses a star for dairy.
Roxy's dairy issue is phrased as a stomach issue ('my stomach makes the rules'), which correctly reads as an intolerance rather than an allergy.
The 'milkshake incident sequel' reference relies on earlier-level continuity. It isn't needed because Roxy spells out the restriction in the next line.
